title: Looking Inside a Folder
objective: Create three files, then list the names of the text files in the practice folder, sorted.
hint: Make the three files first, with Set-Content, using the full folder path in each line. Then use Get-ChildItem with -Path, -Filter "*.txt", and -Name, and pipe the result to Sort-Object. The folder is empty when the script starts, so the listing has to come after the files are made.
